_comment: Known Google Photos features used to compute Novelty Score in opportunity scoring. Update this list before each scoring run. A cluster whose failure_mode is 'addressed' by a feature here gets a lower novelty score.

features.name: People & Pets search
features.description: Automatically groups photos by recognized faces

features.name: Location / Places search
features.description: Search by city, landmark, or GPS location

features.name: Date range filter
features.description: Filter photos by year, month, or custom date range
features.notes: Requires user to know approximate date — does NOT handle vague descriptions like 'last Christmas'

features.name: Object / scene search
features.description: Natural language search for objects (e.g. 'dog', 'birthday cake', 'beach')
features.notes: Works for common objects but fails for niche or contextual descriptions

features.name: Albums
features.description: Manual and auto-created albums (e.g. Trips, Animations)
features.notes: Only useful if user organized photos previously — fails for unorganized libraries

features.name: Memories / On This Day
features.description: Surfaces photos from the same date in previous years
features.notes: Passive — does not help active retrieval of a specific photo

features.name: Lens / Visual search
features.description: Search using a reference image or camera
features.notes: Requires user to have a reference image — not helpful for pure memory-based retrieval
